description: Performance budgets of the node. `max`: the value must stay at or below it (warning from `warning_at` of the budget); `min`: the value must reach it. Metrics without an entry are reported as info. Budgets are product decisions: change a number only in a reviewed pull request (see perf/README.md).

disk.note: A disk whose own commit p95 exceeds this makes the disk-bound write latencies inconclusive (perf/README.md "Noisy runners")

client.slow.start_to_shell_ms.note: start to app shell, 4x CPU throttling

client.desktop.idle_cpu_pct.note: idle in an open channel: CPU <= 1 % of one core

client.desktop.idle_heap_growth_mb.note: idle: no JS heap growth (1 MB tolerance after GC)

client.desktop.idle_requests.note: idle: no network chatter beyond WebSocket pings

client.desktop.ingest_plain_cpu_pct.note: 20 msg/s plaintext: CPU <= 15 % of one core

client.desktop.ingest_enc_cpu_pct.note: 20 msg/s encrypted: CPU <= 15 % of one core

client.desktop.voice_idle_cpu_pct.note: voice connected and idle (muted): renderer process CPU <= 5 % of one core

client.desktop.voice_talk_cpu_pct.note: voice talking (microphone open): renderer process CPU <= 15 % of one core

node.plain_cpu_ref_pct.note: 20 msg/s plaintext: CPU <= 17 % of one core of the reference machine (perf/README.md "Machine speed")

node.enc_cpu_ref_pct.note: 20 msg/s encrypted incl. commits: CPU <= 17 % of one core of the reference machine

node.login_rate_limited.note: Argon2id login has no latency budget; its rate limiter must answer
